title: CaseBoxConfidentialityClassification
description: Per-target confidentiality classification. Append-only history; latest row by set_at (id tiebreak) = current effective level. Targets are document or fact ONLY in v1; matter-level confidentiality lives on the Step-1 matter row. See docs/adr/case-box-step-5-confidentiality-classification.md.

target_type.description: v1 targets. Matter-level classification lives on CaseBoxMatter.confidentiality_class (Step 1), not here.

level.description: Per-item level. unclassified is the legal default (outside the ordinal lattice; operationally most restrictive).

prior_level.description: Null only on the first row for this (target_type, target_id). Persistence enforces cross-row consistency.

change_reason_code.description: Reason taxonomy. Required non-null for downgrades and resets-to-unclassified (enforced by assertValidConfidentialityTransition validator helper, not by schema).
